export_evidence: ImportKey page for PETROGEL (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED (92 G.N.CHETTY RD, T.NAGAR, Chennai) shows 79 customs records, but the visible rows are overwhelmingly INBOUND: e.g. "2026-02-21 | SENECA GLOBAL PLASTIC AND NYLON RAW | PETROGEL (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | LDPE WAX | Taichung, TAIWAN | MUNDRA SEA | 34049020 | BOL 7668339" and "2026-02-14 | HCI WAX CO.,LTD | PETROGEL (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | FULLY REFINED PARAFFIN WAX 64/66 | Dalian, CHINA | CHENNAI SEA | 27122000 | BOL 7537765". The only outbound-looking rows are to Oman: "2026-02-06 | PETROGEL (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | AL FAJAR AL ALAMIA CO .S.A.O.G | PARAFFINIC WAX (GARDE: PIIW) | CHENNAI SEA INMAA1 | Sohar, OMAN | 27122000 | BOL 9444738" and "2026-02-03 | ... Blended Wax Compound Grade:MC WAX (BLEND) | CHENNAI SEA | Sohar, OMAN | 34049090 | BOL 9332357". Counter: page header claims "Total Shipments 79 Records detected / Trading Partners 7 / Ports 11"; only ~5 shipment rows were actually rendered in the free view, of which 2 are India->Oman (Sohar) lines with B/L numbers and dates. No export record was found under the slug variants petrogel-india-pvt-ltd and petrogel-india-pvt-ltd-unit-i (both pages rendered zero shipment rows).
domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the whole session. No domestic supply record was seen, but absence of access is not evidence of absence — recorded as unknown, not none_found.
note: Role appears to be importer/trader of paraffin and LDPE waxes (HS 27122000, 34049020, 34049090) into Chennai/Mundra from Taiwan, Belgium, China, Oman, UAE, Korea; declared HS 340490 and 390290 is consistent with the wax/compound lines actually seen (390290 not observed in any visible row). Two India->Oman lines (B/L 9444738 dated 2026-02-06 and B/L 9332357 dated 2026-02-03, both ex Chennai Sea to Sohar, HS 27122000 and 34049090) are the only outbound evidence, and they are few relative to the 79-record counter, so export activity is classified declared_only rather than confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the sources reachable. No CIN/PAN verified (thecompanycheck blocked). Registry and catalogue data deliberately not used as evidence.
